statement_summary: Study the whole selected Shakespeare play.
Study the whole selected nineteenth-century novel.
Study the whole selected modern text.
Study all 15 selected cluster poems; any may be assessed.
Read a broad range of unfamiliar poems; analyse and compare content, theme, structure and language.
Interpret words in context; distinguish explicit meaning from inference.
Explain plot, character, setting, motivation and causal relationships.
Distinguish themes and support a viewpoint with textual evidence.
Evaluate different readings and develop an informed personal response.
Use social, historical and cultural context to inform evaluation.
Evaluate vocabulary, grammar, structure, form and presentation; use relevant terminology.
Critically compare theme, character, context, style and literary quality where relevant.
Write clearly to describe, explain, summarise, argue, analyse and evaluate; sustain a viewpoint.
Select and emphasise points using relevant quotation and detailed references.
Use accurate Standard English spelling, punctuation and grammar.
